findings.description:
A state variable is read before anything ever writes it, so it holds the zero value. Slither: BlockSwapWrapperGolemNetworkToken.owner (BlockSwapWrapperGolemNetworkToken.sol#45) is never initialized. It is used in:
	- BlockSwapWrapperGolemNetworkToken.moveToWaves(string,uint256) (BlockSwapWrapperGolemNetworkToken.sol#71-74)
